aiAgentSystemPrompt:
You are Muse’s writing agent. Muse is a Markdown editor. Use the tools to inspect, search, and edit workspace documents. Changes made with edit_document, write_document, and insert_into_document require user approval before execution.
Before editing, verify the source with read_document or search_document, then use edit_document for exact replacements. old_text must match the source exactly and occur only once.
Always answer in English using concise Markdown. Do not narrate tool calls; users can inspect them in the interface.
aiAgentDirtyDocument: The document has unsaved changes. read_document/edit_document access the latest editor content.
aiAgentDisabledCapabilities: These capabilities are disabled and their tools are unavailable. Do not call them: {capabilities}.
aiAgentToolGroupDisabled: The “{group}” capability is disabled. Tell the user they can enable it in Settings → Model → Agent Capabilities.
aiAgentReadOnlyPermission: The current permission preset is read-only, so documents cannot be changed. Provide the requested content directly or ask the user to switch to Ask Every Time or Full Access.
aiAgentUserDenied: The user declined this change. Do not retry it unchanged; ask what they would like to do instead.
aiSchemaListDocuments: List files and subdirectories in the workspace to find documents.
aiSchemaReadDocument: Read a document with line numbers. If path is omitted, read the current document. Large files may be truncated; use offset to continue.
aiSchemaSearchDocument: Search a document line by line and return matching lines with their line numbers.
aiSchemaWorkspaceTree: Recursively list workspace directories to inspect the structure.
aiSchemaDocumentStats: Count a document’s characters, lines, and headings.
aiSchemaOpenDocument: Open a document in the editor for the user to view.
aiSchemaEditDocument: Replace old_text with new_text exactly. old_text must match the source exactly and occur only once; use read_document to verify it first.
aiSchemaInsertDocument: Insert Markdown at the beginning or end of the current document.
aiSchemaWriteDocument: Create a Markdown document in the workspace or replace an existing document’s full contents.
aiSchemaRenameDocument: Rename or move a file, including into another subdirectory.
aiSchemaDeleteDocument: Move a file to the system Trash, where it can be restored.
aiSchemaCreateFolder: Create a folder in the workspace, including nested directories.
aiSchemaPathSubdir: Workspace-relative subdirectory; defaults to the workspace root.
aiSchemaPathCurrent: Workspace-relative path; defaults to the current document.
aiSchemaPathRequired: Path relative to the workspace root.
aiSchemaPathFolder: Folder path relative to the workspace root.
aiSchemaLimit: Maximum number of lines to read; defaults to 300.
aiSchemaRegex: Treat query as a regular expression; defaults to case-insensitive literal search.
aiSchemaOldText: Exact source text to replace; it must occur only once.
aiSchemaNewText: Replacement text; an empty string deletes the source text.
aiSchemaInsertPosition: Insertion position; defaults to the end.
aiAgentPathEditableText: The new path must point to an editable text file (such as md, markdown, or txt).
aiAgentDirtyDelete: The current document has unsaved changes. Save or discard them before deleting it.
aiAgentNotEditable: This is not an editable text file.
aiAgentCurrentNotSaved: The current document has not been saved. Save it first or provide a workspace-relative path.
aiAgentWorkspaceOnly: Only files inside the workspace can be accessed.
aiAgentNoWorkspaceOrDocument: There is no open workspace or saved document.
aiAgentCurrentDocumentEmpty: The current document is empty. Add content or provide a workspace path.
aiAgentFileTooLarge: File exceeds 2 MB and cannot be read.
aiAgentNotTextFile: This is not a text file.
aiAgentOffsetOutOfRange: Offset {offset, number} exceeds the total line count of {total, number}.
aiAgentOldTextEmpty: old_text is required. Use read_document to verify the source, then copy the exact text to replace.
aiAgentOldTextNotFound: old_text was not found in the document. Use read_document to verify the source, including spaces and line breaks.
aiAgentOldTextRepeated: old_text occurs {count, number} times. Include more text so the match is unique.
aiAgentWritePathExample: A path is required relative to the workspace root, for example notes/meeting.md.
aiAgentNoWritableDocument: There is no writable document. Create or open one first.
